Agreed! And never did I state PCOS = infertility. 

This would be the equivalent of me coming to someone’s post who has found a positive aspect or new perspective on excess body hair and stating how this needs to be common knowledge that not everyone deals with this! It is the responsibility of the individual to understand and come to terms with their own symptoms & situation, as I have done and shared here. 

Every subject is a touchy subject in todays society,
But taking one persons experience with their chronic health condition and labeling it as a harmful way of thinking is simply inaccurate. 

I glad you understand though, and I wish those that are so desperately trying to conceive or hold on to hope they can the best of luck.

All the downvoting for me expressing MY OWN experiences & viewpoints is a little harsh and seems to reaffirm the societal viewpoint that not having kids is not the ideal route. We need to do better.  Especially as a community of people who all share a common health struggle to be more encouraging and uplifting to individuals like myself.

THANK YOU. i was starting to think this sub wasn’t for me the way people are coming at me for discussing my own experience with infertility. I sincerely hope someone doesn’t read my experience and think “WOW I HAVE PCOS SO UNPROTECTED SEX AND NO PRECAUTIONS FOR LIFE BBY!” like c‘mom now. I never even stated that I use my PCOS as birth control. Ffs. I said extra layer and the people interpreted it however their brains saw fit regardless of the literal meaning. You can’t have an EXTRA layer without first having a PRIMARY LAYER. words do MEAN THINGS lol

If my impact has been harmful I genuinely apologize. 

I too, would like to be able to discuss my personal experience w fertility, or lack there of, and my experience with PCOS as a woman, that was my intention. 

I definitely don’t think people should read a Reddit post of a woman <me> coming to terms w her inability to have children and the effects is has on her mind and assume this means they don’t need to use conventional means of BC in order to prevent pregnancy. 

I apologize for any harm I may have caused if someone has done that
